summary: All positions are UVY (2F floor Y 7.0) from anchor src-hash: seam-9yw SfM, 134/135 frames 186-230.7 s. The 186.0 and 230.3-230.7 s frames are mis-registered and not used. The registration is tight at the exit-8 end (within 0.1-0.3 m near U 60-65) and looser toward the concourse (±0.5-1 m at 15-20 m from exit 8). Main finding: the source MainShell facade line at V 11.7-12.2 (U 55-65, e.g. the jog at 58.52,11.69) is open floor in the video. The LED wall, the A1 column and the women's toilet entrance all lie SOUTH of it, in the space the live model calls '연결 통로'. The walker comes south from the concourse (U 46.9, V 29.7 at 193 s), turns east at about 207 s and ends facing exit 8 (U 58.8, V 12.3, heading +U, at 228 s).
